title: Capital Flows — income → digital credit → liquidity → deploy
notes: Col 1 Income order: Turo · Lyft · X Creator (planned) · TREAD (planned) · ASICs. Planned cards: brown dashed border, no flow edges. Active: Turo→Coinbase funnel; Lyft/ASICs→Coinbase. Col 2 Digital Credit · Col 3 Liquidity Engine · Col 4 Deploy: Essential (Personal) · Fleet · Collateral · Productive Disc. · Consumer Disc. · One Card · Agentic Fund. X Money funds Essential/Fleet/Collateral/disc buckets. No edge text labels.

legend.observed: Seen in YNAB/Plaid or expense sheet

income_sources.label: Turo
income_sources.evidence: First-touch ops land X Money (cannot direct-deposit to Coinbase). Map draws Turo→Coinbase for capitalization engine funnel; card still shows *X Money* italic + gray border.

income_sources.label: Lyft
income_sources.evidence: Weekly payout lands on Coinbase — enters Digital Credit engine directly.

income_sources.label: X Creator
income_sources.evidence: Future plan — not an active income source yet. Intended first-touch X Money. Biweekly. No map edges until live.

income_sources.label: TREAD
income_sources.evidence: Future plan — not an active income source yet. Intended first-touch X Money. Monthly. No map edges until live.

income_sources.label: ASICs
income_sources.evidence: Every other month to Coinbase (Braiins). Owner threshold 0.01 BTC. Enters Digital Credit engine directly.

braiins_pool.purpose: Read ASIC hashrate / payout stats directly instead of inferring from Coinbase deposits
braiins_pool.notes: Sync via treasury/braiins_sync.py → treasury/snapshots/braiins_latest.json. Token: ~/.config/braiins/token or BRAIINS_POOL_TOKEN. Account payout threshold: treasury/config.json braiins.payout_threshold_btc (0.01 as of 2026-08-05).
braiins_pool.cadence_hint: Poll daily or after expected payout window; FCC capital-flows reads braiins_latest.json live strip

channels.label: Coinbase
channels.subtitle: Income funnel · engine entry
channels.notes: Central hub: all income streams target CB for capitalization (Turo via X Money hop).

channels.label: Morpho · BTC loan
channels.subtitle: Collateralize BTC · borrow USDC
channels.notes: Conclusion of Digital Credit: BTC-backed Morpho loan. Borrowed USDC fans out to X Money, USDC HY, and USDG HY (Liquidity Engine).

channels.label: X Money
channels.subtitle: ~6% APY · Turo land + ops
channels.notes: Liquidity Engine cash sleeve (gray border) — Turo first-touch + Morpho USDC share + ops float.

channels.label: USDC High Yield
channels.subtitle: Idle Morpho USDC
channels.notes: Blue border. Morpho-borrowed USDC park sleeve.

channels.label: USDG High Yield
channels.subtitle: Idle Morpho → USDG yield
channels.notes: Green border. Morpho USDC path into USDG high-yield sleeve.

channels.label: Essential
channels.subtitle: Personal · must-pay bills
channels.notes: Expense sheet Personal tab — essential burn; highest spend priority. Funded via X Money + Coinbase.

channels.label: Fleet
channels.subtitle: Auto fleet · loans / ops
channels.notes: Expense sheet Fleet tab — auto fleet expenses (loans, insurance, wash, repairs). Burn; funded primarily via X Money.

channels.label: Collateral
channels.subtitle: Capital · investments
channels.notes: Expense sheet Collateral tab — collateral / productive capital investments (not expense burn). Funded via X Money.

channels.label: Productive Discretionary
channels.subtitle: Capex · grow assets
channels.notes: Expense sheet Productive Discretionary — capital outlay that grows productive base. Priority over consumer wishlist.

channels.label: Consumer Discretionary
channels.subtitle: Wishlist · after productive
channels.notes: Expense sheet Consumer Discretionary — consumer goods / personal wishlist; lower priority than Productive.

edges.notes: Engine funnel (not first-touch ACH). Card shows X Money italic.
Essential / Personal bills from X Money — highest spend priority.
Auto fleet expenses (loans/insurance/ops) paid from X Money.
Collateral investments funded from X Money (not burn).
Productive Discretionary funded after essentials + fleet.
Consumer Discretionary funded last among expense buckets.
Agentic Fund funded from USDG High Yield.
